subject: Mutual action plan — kickoff, owners & timeline options
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medsight.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mutual action plan — kickoff, owners & timeline options

Hi Samira — thanks again for the discovery call today. Quick recap and an initial MAP I sketched for alignment. Please review and confirm stakeholders/target close so we can lock milestones.

Key outcomes from the call
- Primary goals: integrate Redwood inference for clinical summarization and search; target latency SLA of <=250ms median for the POC.
- Primary constraints: strict data residency and SOC2 evidence required for procurement.

Initial MAP (draft) — milestones & suggested owners
1) Kickoff + scope sign-off (Owner: Karthik) — deliverable: scope doc + success criteria
2) Security & compliance review (Owner: Marissa) — deliverable: security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence checklist
3) POC implementation (Owner: MediSight Eng + Redwood SE) — deliverable: POC results + perf report
4) Procurement & legal review (Owner: Arjun / MediSight procurement) — deliverable: signed PO / contract
5) Production readiness & rollout (Owner: Monika / Redwood customer success) — deliverable: runbook and SLA agreement

Timeline options (pick one or propose):
- Option A (aggressive): 6-8 weeks — fast-track security review + parallel POC (recommended if procurement can fast-follow)
- Option B (conservative): 10-12 weeks — sequential security sign-off then procurement then POC

Dependencies and blockers
- SOC2 evidence access (logs, controls) — critical path for procurement
- Procurement windows / budget approvals (Arjun)
- Integrations: Okta SSO and S3 access for dataset exchange

Next steps (ask)
- Can you confirm primary stakeholders for security and procurement (names & emails)?
- Which timeline option do you prefer and what is your target close date?
- Are you available for a 30-min MAP kickoff on either Tue 1/20 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 1/21 14:00–14:30 PT?

I've attached the initial MAP draft (MAP_initial_draft_v1.xlsx) and a shared drive link to the doc for inline comments. If OK, I'll update ownerships and circulate MAP_v1.1 after we agree stakeholders.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@medsight.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan — kickoff, owners & timeline options

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the clear draft. A few quick answers from our side and a couple of priorities.

On Thu, Jan 14, 2026 at 3:12 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> (initial MAP included)

Stakeholders (MediSight):
- Samira Khan — Program owner (samira.khan@medsight.io)
- Arjun Patel — Procurement lead (arjun.patel@medsight.io)
- Lina Gomez — Security lead (lina.gomez@medsight.io)

Priorities / constraints:
- Security/compliance is our gating item. Lina will need the SOC2 evidence and a short Q&A before procurement signs off.
- Procurement timeline: Arjun estimates legal/PO approval could take 3–4 weeks once security clears.

Target close: we are aiming for mid-March. Can we align on a target close date of 2026-03-15? That gives us room for a 10-week plan but we may try the aggressive track if security can parallelize.

I attached our internal security questionnaire answers (Security_Q_A.pdf) — Lina will follow up with specific evidence requests.

I can do Tue 1/20 10:00 PT for the kickoff.

Cheers,
Samira
Program Manager — Product Integrations
MediSight Health

Samira — perfect, thanks for the clarity.

On Thu, Jan 15, 2026 at 9:03 AM Samira Khan <samira.khan@medsight.io> wrote:
> Target close: 2026-03-15

I updated the MAP with the stakeholder names you provided and made a few ownership tweaks (attached MAP_v1.1.xlsx). Summary of updates below: 
- Security & compliance (Marissa) — start immediately; Marissa will send the evidence checklist and request scope for SOC2 artifacts
- Procurement (Arjun) — noted as primary approver; procurement timeline marked as a blocker in the plan
- POC schedule — propose week-of 2/9 to begin dev integration if kickoff happens 1/20

Revised target close: keeping 2026-03-15 as your stated goal — I'll mark that as target close in HubSpot (hubspot:6789123) and in the MAP. If security needs more time we should default to Option B and adjust the POC window.

Dependencies I'm tracking: SOC2 evidence access, legal review turnaround, and a small engineering task list for Okta SSO. If you can confirm Arjun as procurement contact and Lina as security contact for evidence exchange, Marissa will reach out to Lina directly to request artifacts.

I proposed and scheduled the 30-min kickoff for Tue 1/20 10:00 PT — calendar invite coming shortly.

Thanks — I'll circulate MAP_v1.1 after Marissa and Lina connect.

—Karthik
